about: THE BUILD TARGETS (kb/Work PB5207, PB5218; scripts/buildgraph.py): each test assembly is a target with DECLARED INPUTS, and its key is a digest of the git blob ids of the tracked paths those inputs match, minus the excluded classes, plus its facets. A pass is recorded once per target and key in the one store every worktree shares. An input missed here is a FALSE GREEN, so every entry names its reader, and `python scripts/buildgraph.py check` (the BUILD TARGETS audit) fails when a test source of an assembly names a repository path outside its target's inputs.

build.about: What building a test assembly and the compiler it tests reads, shared by every test target ('@build').

inputs.src/: every product project (the compiler, the runtime, the CLI the suites drive)
inputs.Directory.Build.props: the root props every project imports
inputs..gitattributes: the checkout's bytes of every file a test reads
inputs.toolchain.env: the tool versions (also the toolchain facet)
inputs.tests/Directory.Build.props: the test-tree props: links tests/_shared/*.cs and the weights into every test project
inputs.tests/_shared/: linked into every test project (TestRepo, SuiteManifest, the gate framework, the weights)

inputs.@build: the compiler, the runtime and the CLI it tests, and the sources its sweeps read (src/)
inputs.tests/WiseOwl.Cobol.Tests.Unit/: its own sources, project and data (Architecture/binder-member-readers.json, Store/, TestData/)
inputs.specs/ISO_COBOL_2023.md: the ORACLE the compiler's tables are derived from and checked against (SpecClauseText and ~40 table drift tests: Table12StatementNameDriftTests, PictureTable10DriftTests, ...)
inputs.data/unicode/: the pinned UCD and CLDR tables the runtime's generated tables come from (CollationTableTests, CldrCollationSettingsTests, GraphemeBreakerTests)
inputs.docs/rearchitecture/spec-rule-catalog.js: the standard's rules as the catalog extracts them (EcRaiseSiteDriftTests); SuiteManifest's generate.py (the inventory view)
inputs.docs/rearchitecture/spec-rule-catalog-19: SuiteManifest's generate.py (the inventory view of the 1985 edition)
inputs.tests/version-matrix/constructs/: the construct catalogue (TestRepo.ConstructRows: ConstructRegistryDriftTests, DataBinderNameReferenceDriftTests, DocumentedFactsDriftTests, RegistryShapeDriftTests); SuiteManifest's generate.py
inputs.tests/version-matrix/inventory/: SuiteManifest's generate.py ONLY (it refuses a test naming a rule the inventory lacks; traced, kb/Work PB5218): no Unit test reads the inventory, and kb/Work PB5231 replaces these generator inputs with the generator target's output
inputs.tests/nist/: the NIST corpus programs a compiler test compiles (StorageFormEquivalenceTests, LexerDfaCacheDriftTests)
inputs.conformance-suite/: the suite's programs, options and adapter (TestRepo.SuiteCase, LexerDfaCacheDriftTests, NumericDisplayFormDriftTests, ConformanceSuiteAdapterDriftTests) and SuiteManifest, which runs harness/generate.py --out
inputs.tests/doc-facts/: the compiler facts the documents state and the manual's programs (DocFacts, DocumentedFactsDriftTests, UserManualDriftTests)
inputs.scripts/spec/construct_store.py: SuiteManifest's generate.py imports it (traced, kb/Work PB5218)

judged.tests/_shared/TrackedTree.cs|: `git ls-files` at the root: the names it returns are filtered by the caller's TreeScope before any caller sees one, and each scope's Under prefixes are literal reads the audit judges in that caller (TrackedTreeScopeDriftTests holds every TrackedTree.Files call to a declared scope; a whole-tree scope, Under "", is a bare root reference there)
judged.tests/_shared/GateLegAudit.cs|: GateLegAudit.HostRoot: the root AS TEXT, which arm (5) matches discovered case names against; no file is read through it
judged.tests/_shared/PythonInstrument.cs|: the working directory of the one Python script a Unit test runs, SuiteManifest's conformance-suite/harness/generate.py --out, whose reads are the generator inputs declared above (traced, kb/Work PB5218)

inputs.@population-inputs: the repository's drift tests bind the documents' data files, the records, the scripts a compiler test runs, the CI files, every test source and the NAMES of every tracked file (tests/_shared/TrackedTree.cs, NulByteDriftTests' whole-tree sweep) to each other and to the compiler: every population input (inert_lane.Classification.is_population_input)

inputs.@build: the compiler, the runtime and the CLI it builds and runs
inputs.tests/WiseOwl.Cobol.Tests.Conformance/: its own sources, project and data
inputs.conformance-suite/: the suite's tests, adapters and harness (SuiteManifest runs harness/generate.py --out; ConformanceSuite runs harness/run.py)
inputs.tests/nist/: the NIST corpus, its manifest, data and goldens (CorpusManifest, NistRunner)
inputs.tests/version-matrix/: the construct catalogue (VersionBehaviorMatrixTests) and, through harness/generate.py, the traceability inventory of both editions, inventory-schema.json, reserved-words.json, annex-a2-undefined.json and conformance-register.json (traced run of generate.py --out, kb/Work PB5218)
inputs.scripts/spec/: harness/generate.py imports construct_store, inventory_schema, inventory_view, inventory_store, lineage, generated_output
